paite: Huan van ah chiamtehna thupi tak hongkimuta a: numei nia kijem, leh a khe nuaia kha om leh a lu tunga lallukhu aksi sawm leh nih tuang;
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

paite: Huan nau a paia; huan nau vei leh suak khe ding natnain a kap kheta a.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

paite: Huan van thil lamdang a dang khat ahongkimu a; huan ngaiin, dragon san lianpi, lu sagih leh ki sawm neia, a lu tunga lallukhu sagih nei.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

paite: Huan a meiin vana aksite mun thuma khen mun khat a kaia, huan leitungah a pai kheta a; huan dragon tuh huai numei nau nei dia kisa maah a dinga, a neih chianga a nau tuh nekzoh vek tumin.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

paite: Huan tapa, nau pasal, sik chianga nam tengteng tunga vaihawm ding a neita a; huan a ta tuh Pathian leh a laltutphah ah lak touhin a omta hi.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.

paite: Huan numei tuh gamdai ah, Pathian amaha dia a mun bawlsak ah, huaia amah ni sangkhat leh ni zanih leh ni sawmguk a khawia om ding in, a lata hi.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

paite: Huan van ah kidouna a omta a: Mikael leh angelte tuh dragon toh kidou dingin a kuan khia ua; huan dragon leh a angelten a dou ua;
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

paite: Huan a zou kei ua, a mun uh van ah muh himhim a om nawnta keia.
english: They didn’t prevail, neither was a place found for him any more in heaven.

paite: Huan dragon lian, gulpi tek, Diabol leh Setan chiha ompa, khovel pumpi khempa tuh paih khiak sukin a omta a, huan amah toh a angelte leng a paih khiak sukin a omta uhi.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

paite: Huan van ah aw ngaihtak mai ka zata a, Tun ah hongtungta i Pathian hotdamna, thilhihtheihna, leh Kris thuneihna; i unaute hekpa, i Pathian maa sun leh jana amau hekpa paih khiak suka a om jiakin.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

paite: Huan Belamnou sisan jiak leh theihpih uh thu jiakin amah tungah tuh a vual zouta ua; huan sihtan phain leng a hinna uh a it kei uhi.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

paite: Huaijiakin kipak un, aw van leh nou a sunga tengte. Lei leh tuipi adingin atung uh a gik; diabolin tuh hun tom chikphet a nei chih a kitheih jiakin a heh mahmaha na kiang uah a hongpai sukta ngala, chiin.
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

paite: Huan dragon leitunga paih khiak a hita chih a kithei takin, huai numei nau pasal neinu tuh a gawtta a.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

paite: Huan numei kiangah tuh munvanlai thupi tak kha nih piakin a omta a, huan gulpi maia kipan gamdai muna a len lut theihna dingin, huailai ah tuh hun khat sung leh hun teleh hun kimkhat sung khawiin a om hi.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

paite: Huan gulpiin tuh a kama kipanin tuipi bang tui numei nungah a sekheta a, huai tuiluanga amah tuh a taih mangsak theihna dingin.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

paite: Huan leiin tuh numei a panpihta a, huan leiin tuh a kam a kata a, huan dragonin a kama kipana a lui tui siat khiak tuh a navalh zoh sak vekta hi.Huan dragon tuh numei tungah a heh mahmaha, huan a suan dangte, Pathian thupiak juite leh Jesu thutheihpihna juite vakidou pih dingin a pai mangta hi.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

paite: Huan dragon tuh numei tungah a heh mahmaha, huan a suan dangte, Pathian thupiak juite leh Jesu thutheihpihna juite vakidou pih dingin a pai mangta hi.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.
